## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO gate aims to capture the edge by vetoing call entries when a bearish structure is confirmed, thus avoiding wrong-way trades and preserving winning trades.

## Mechanism

The gate will use the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function to classify the trend as bearish or bullish. If the trend is bearish, the gate will veto call entries.
